title: Baruch: Sages Whose Father Was Named Baruch
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: (Baruch ben Neriah—Jeremiah 32:12.) Rav Nachman bar Baruch—Shabbat 66b; Nechemyah bar Baruch—Moed Katan 16a. Hyman identifies them as one person, reporting that Dikdukei Soferim also reads Nechemyah bar Baruch in Shabbat 66b. In Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5, Rabbi Yehudah son of Rabbi Ilai says, “Baruch Rabbi used to expound.” Hyman suggests a printing error, since he finds no Tanna of that name elsewhere. He proposes that it means that he blessed his teacher when mentioning him.

notes.text: Hyman identifies Nachman bar Baruch and Nechemyah bar Baruch, and separately proposes that “Baruch Rabbi” is not a personal name but a blessing of the teacher. Both are his claims.

The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5 contains “Baruch Rabbi.” Hyman’s blessing interpretation, printing-error proposal and Nachman/Nechemyah identification remain his claims; the exact Dikdukei Soferim reading was not inspected.
